payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a pencil drawing, with its visual content represented in a pencil-drawn style.
outcome.reference: The supplied image and the requested pencil-drawing transformation.

check.question: Does the image visibly appear as a completed pencil drawing?
check.complete_when: The image is visibly rendered throughout as a pencil drawing, with drawing-like linework and tonal rendering across the image; residual color is acceptable if the image still reads as a pencil drawing. Color reduction or a filter-like appearance alone is not sufficient.
check.partial_when: Visible pencil-drawing linework and tonal rendering are present, but the transformation is incomplete or only affects part of the image.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no pencil-drawing transformation has been made.
check.unknown_when: The image or its style cannot be assessed confidently.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has reduced, muted color and a faint grainy, sketch-like texture, but it lacks clear pencil-drawn linework and tonal rendering throughout; it still reads mainly as a filtered photograph rather than a completed pencil drawing."}

parsed.evidence: The edited image has reduced, muted color and a faint grainy, sketch-like texture, but it lacks clear pencil-drawn linework and tonal rendering throughout; it still reads mainly as a filtered photograph rather than a completed pencil drawing.
